verdict.rationale: Grok Build is a coding agent driven by natural-language prompts. The docs show plain-language requests such as "Explain this repo", "@src/main.rs Walk me through this file" and "watch the deploy logs and tell me if anything errors". Recurring prompts work via /loop, side questions via /btw, and plan mode drafts a plan from a request for approval before editing; headless -p runs the same prompts in scripts. Hands-on users praise the harness as smooth and effective in real projects. Missing for 10: verified evidence that product configuration and settings can be changed through natural language rather than config files and slash commands (the one community report of this is unverified).
